cards.headline: S&P 500 loses record $2.9 trillion as AI rout deepens
cards.summary: US stocks fell sharply Thursday. The FT put Wall Street's loss at $3.2 trillion and the Nasdaq 100 down 6.4%. MarketWatch called it tech's worst day since 2020, and CNBC said the Magnificent 7 lost $1 trillion.
cards.why_it_matters: Retirement accounts and index funds are heavily weighted to these stocks, so the losses reach ordinary savers.

sources.title: Wall Street sheds $3.2tn as Democratic midterm sweep triggers brutal AI rout
Tech stocks log worst day since 2020 as carnage comes to the AI trade
Magnificent 7 loses $1 trillion. The most eye-popping stats from Thursday's tech stock plunge

cards.headline: Asian markets brace for losses as Korean chip stocks sink 10%
cards.summary: Futures point to steep declines in Japan and elsewhere in Asia on Friday. South Korean chip stocks fell about 10% in pre-market trading on fears a Democratic Congress will slow AI infrastructure expansion.
cards.why_it_matters: The selloff is spreading globally, and Asian chipmakers supply much of the hardware in US devices.

sources.title: Korean Chip Stocks Sink 10% in Pre-Market as AI Fears Deepen
Japanese Equities Set to Plunge as AI Selloff Continues

cards.headline: Neocloud IREN says $4 billion in annualized revenue is delayed
cards.summary: IREN said some revenue is being pushed from 2026 into early next year at a customer's request, after a sharp stock drop. MarketWatch reported the shares later rose on a new cloud deal and investment-grade backlog.
cards.why_it_matters: Delays at AI cloud providers feed investor doubts about how fast data center spending turns into revenue.

sources.title: Neocloud IREN says $4 billion in annualized revenue being delayed due to customer request
Here’s what’s driving Iren’s stock higher after a brutal selloff

cards.headline: Meta warns data center backlash could make AI expansion harder
cards.summary: Meta said growing political opposition to data centers, shown in the election, could threaten future AI investment as communities push back against large infrastructure projects.
cards.why_it_matters: Local fights over power and water now shape where AI gets built and what it costs.

sources.title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder

cards.headline: House Republicans ask Nvidia's Huang to brief Congress on China ties
cards.summary: Three House Republican committee chairs asked Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang for a closed-door briefing about reported ties to a woman accused of spying for China. Nvidia's response was not in the reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Nvidia chips are central to US-China technology rivalry and to the AI boom.

sources.title: Nvidia CEO called in by lawmakers over ties to alleged Chinese spy
Top GOP House lawmakers want Nvidia's Jensen Huang to come to Congress

cards.headline: Trump says Iran war decision is coming soon
cards.summary: After meeting his national security team, Trump said he will soon decide whether to resume all-out war with Iran. Bloomberg reports oil is heading for its biggest weekly loss since April as investors weigh prospects of an end to the war.
cards.why_it_matters: The choice affects US troops, gasoline prices and the wider Gulf region.

sources.title: Trump meets with national security team, says Iran war decision coming "soon"
Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 6

cards.headline: Saudi-led coalition intercepts missile fired toward Medina
cards.summary: A Saudi-led coalition intercepted a missile fired toward Medina. Al Jazeera says it followed a Saudi civil defence warning of potential danger near the port of Yanbu. The origin of the launch was not stated in the summary.
cards.why_it_matters: An attack near Islam's second-holiest city and a key oil port could widen regional tensions and unsettle energy markets.

sources.title: Saudi coalition intercepts missile fired towards Medina

cards.headline: Iran war is draining US naval forces from the western Pacific
cards.summary: Defense One reports the war on Iran is pulling US naval forces out of the western Pacific. One expert called it a problem for credibility and for allies in the Far East.
cards.why_it_matters: Thinner US presence in Asia affects deterrence against China and the confidence of allies like Japan and South Korea.

sources.title: The war on Iran is stripping the western Pacific of US naval forces

cards.headline: RAF Fairford air show moved permanently after suspected terror threat
cards.summary: Organizers of the world's largest military air show said it is leaving RAF Fairford for MOD Boscombe Down, over a month after a suspected Iranian plot against the base.
cards.why_it_matters: Fairford hosts US forces, and the plot shows how the Iran conflict reaches allied bases in Europe.

sources.title: Popular military air show permanently pulled from RAF Fairford after suspected terror threat

cards.headline: Nithya Raman declared winner of Los Angeles mayoral race
cards.summary: Democratic socialist Nithya Raman defeated incumbent Mayor Karen Bass and will be the city's first South Asian mayor. She campaigned on homelessness and affordable housing, and Axios noted New York's Zohran Mamdani is also a democratic socialist.
cards.why_it_matters: The nation's two largest cities will now have democratic socialist mayors, a shift in big-city Democratic politics.

sources.title: Democratic socialist Nithya Raman wins Los Angeles mayoral race over incumbent Karen Bass
Raman ousts Bass in LA mayor race for historic socialist win
Los Angeles elects democratic socialist Nithya Raman as mayor

cards.headline: Democrats flip more House seats in North Carolina, Arizona and New York
cards.summary: Democrats flipped five Republican-held North Carolina seats, drawn in 2023 to favor Republicans, plus Arizona's 6th, where JoAnna Mendoza beat Rep. Juan Ciscomani. Cait Conley is projected to beat Rep. Mike Lawler. Republican Paul LePage flipped Maine's 2nd.
cards.why_it_matters: The scale of Democratic gains shapes the size of the new House majority and its agenda.

sources.title: What the blue wave looked like in North Carolina
Ex-Biden official projected to win bid to unseat Mike Lawler in high-stakes House race
JoAnna Mendoza flips Arizona’s toss-up 6th Congressional District seat

cards.headline: FBI and Congress widen scrutiny of Alaska 'Decoy Dan' candidacy
cards.summary: Fox News reports the FBI interviewed former Alaska Republican lawmaker David Eastman, who described a mystery recruiter. Fox says a Democratic operative allegedly posed as a conservative recruiter in the Senate race; the claim is unproven.
cards.why_it_matters: The inquiry bears on a Senate race still too close to call and on rules for candidate recruitment.

sources.title: Ex-Alaska lawmaker details mystery recruiter as FBI, Congress widen 'Decoy Dan' scrutiny

cards.headline: Transgender and noncitizen-voting measures pass in several states
cards.summary: Voters in Nebraska and Arizona approved restrictive transgender ballot measures, the Washington Examiner reports. Fox News says five states approved noncitizen voting bans. STAT reports voters also decided abortion, marijuana and transgender youth care measures.
cards.why_it_matters: The results show where state-level policy on contested social issues moved even as Democrats won nationally.

sources.title: Why conservative transgender ballot measures passed amid blue wave
Democrats ‘divorced from voters’ as 5 states back citizen-only voting, bolstering GOP push
Ballot measures affirm divisions over abortion and transgender issues

cards.headline: Hegseth authorizes boats, Humvees and patrol cars for DC Guard
cards.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth authorized the National Guard in Washington to use boats, up to 60 marked police cars and military tactical vehicles, a Pentagon official confirmed. Fox reports a D.C. council hearing demanded the military presence be removed.
cards.why_it_matters: It expands a military role in the capital's policing, a live dispute over federal power and local control.

sources.title: National Guard to use boats, Humvees in expanded DC presence
Hegseth expands National Guard operations in DC, authorizes police patrol cars, Humvees and boats

cards.headline: Hegseth seeks $350 billion for military and rejects impeachment push
cards.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth urged Congress to approve $350 billion in military funding and said he will fight Democratic impeachment efforts. Breaking Defense says reconciliation, appropriations and the NDAA will compete for attention.
cards.why_it_matters: A Democratic House could use the defense budget and impeachment threats to challenge Pentagon priorities.

sources.title: Hegseth demands $350B for military, fires back at Dem impeachment push
Republicans have a ticking clock. What can they get done on defense?

cards.headline: Trump signs proclamation making Oval Office a national monument
cards.summary: Trump signed a proclamation designating the Oval Office and Cabinet Room a national monument. He noted Congress would have to ratify it, and that no major modifications could be made without congressional approval.
cards.why_it_matters: It is an unusual use of monument powers on the seat of the presidency; its legal effect depends on Congress.

sources.title: Trump signs proclamation making Oval Office, Cabinet Room national monument

cards.headline: Trump adviser urges Senate Republicans to look beyond Thune
cards.summary: Trump adviser Alex Bruesewitz publicly called on Senate Republicans to consider an alternative to Majority Leader John Thune, saying the party was rewarding failure after its midterm losses. Thune has not responded in the reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Leadership fights inside the GOP affect how the party opposes a Democratic Congress.

sources.title: Trump adviser calls for alternative to Thune for Senate GOP leader

cards.headline: Rep. Casten challenges Maxine Waters for top Financial Services post
cards.summary: Rep. Sean Casten (D-Ill.) formally launched a bid to chair the House Financial Services Committee, challenging longtime Democratic leader Rep. Maxine Waters. He asked colleagues for support in a letter.
cards.why_it_matters: The chair would steer oversight of banks, crypto and housing finance in a Democratic House.

sources.title: Sean Casten launches bid for House Financial Services chair

cards.headline: Epstein files return to the spotlight as Congress reconvenes
cards.summary: Axios reports Congress returns next week facing a renewed push for transparency on the Jeffrey Epstein files, as a top House Democrat promises new investigations after the party's midterm victories.
cards.why_it_matters: Democratic control gives the party subpoena power over an issue that has divided both parties.

sources.title: Epstein files back in spotlight after midterms

cards.headline: Rubio denies resignation rumors, will speak to Federalist Society
cards.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio will headline the Federalist Society's National Lawyers Convention next week, his first speech since the midterms. The Washington Examiner says the news came as rumors of his resignation circulated; he has denied them.
cards.why_it_matters: The top US diplomat's status matters for the Iran war, Ukraine talks and relations with allies.

sources.title: Rubio to deliver first post-midterm speech as he denies resignation rumors

cards.headline: MAHA movement faces uncertain future after midterm losses
cards.summary: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s Make America Healthy Again movement faces a shaky alliance with Republicans after key allies lost. MAHA leader Tony Lyons said he is willing to work with Democrats who share his vision.
cards.why_it_matters: The movement's influence shapes federal food, vaccine and chronic disease policy.

sources.title: Following midterm losses, MAHA is at a crossroads
MAHA lost bigly in the midterms—is it at death's door?
MAHA leader open to working with Democrats who won't fight RFK Jr.

cards.headline: Wisconsin reports infant measles death, first since 1990
cards.summary: Wisconsin health officials said an infant died in connection with the state's ongoing measles outbreak, the first measles death there in more than 30 years. The coroner listed the immediate cause of death.
cards.why_it_matters: Measles is preventable by vaccine, and the death shows the stakes of the continuing outbreak.

sources.title: Wisconsin reports first measles death since 1990
Child dies of measles in Wisconsin’s first such death since 1990

cards.headline: October jobs report due Friday after tech-stock rout
cards.summary: The Bureau of Labor Statistics releases October nonfarm payrolls Friday at 8:30 a.m. ET. MarketWatch says it could bring investors relief or add to losses after the tech selloff.
cards.why_it_matters: Jobs data feeds directly into the Fed's December decision on interest rates.

sources.title: The October jobs report is out Friday. Here's everything to expect
After tech-stock rout, October jobs report could bring relief — or more pain

cards.headline: Canada's budget funds sovereignty and homelessness using oil windfall
cards.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney plans to use an oil revenue windfall to bolster Canada's economic and cultural sovereignty and address cost-of-living concerns, with billions for sovereignty and tackling homelessness.
cards.why_it_matters: Canada is the largest US trading partner, and its push for sovereignty affects cross-border trade and defense ties.

sources.title: Canada's federal budget includes billions for sovereignty and tackling homelessness

cards.headline: Brazil lists rare earths and copper as top critical minerals
cards.summary: Brazil approved its first list of critical and strategic minerals under a new national policy meant to attract investment and expand domestic processing, with rare earths and copper at the top.
cards.why_it_matters: Western countries are seeking minerals outside China, and Brazil could become a larger supplier for US industry.

sources.title: Brazil Puts Rare Earths, Copper Atop Critical Minerals List

cards.headline: ANC on track for record low in South African local elections
cards.summary: With more than 60% of votes counted in municipal elections, the African National Congress had about 32% of the vote, according to Al Jazeera.
cards.why_it_matters: A weaker ANC could reshape coalition politics in Africa's most industrialized economy.

sources.title: South Africa’s ANC on track for new lows in local polls

cards.headline: Hoax bomb threats hit 27 flights; no confirmed link to Russia or Iran
cards.summary: Hoax bomb threats caused emergency landings and evacuations across Europe, targeting at least 27 flights. The BBC says there is no hard evidence linking them to Russia, Iran or proxies, though hybrid-warfare concerns persist.
cards.why_it_matters: Disruption affects travelers, including Americans in Europe, and raises questions about hybrid attacks on the continent.

sources.title: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?
Hoax bomb threats force emergency landings, evacuations across Europe

cards.headline: Police investigating two more rape allegations against Russell Brand
cards.summary: The lead detective urged other potential victims to come forward after it emerged Russell Brand is under investigation for two further rape allegations and faces a civil case. Brand was convicted of rape earlier this week.
cards.why_it_matters: The investigation shows how a high-profile conviction can prompt further complaints.

sources.title: Police investigating two further rape allegations against Russell Brand

cards.headline: Former Turkish minister Kaya arrested in investment fund probe
cards.summary: Fatma Betul Sayan Kaya, former deputy chair of President Erdogan's AK Party, was arrested in an investigation into alleged manipulation involving investment funds and stocks, state-run Anadolu Agency reported.
cards.why_it_matters: The case touches Turkey's ruling party and its financial markets, a major NATO member's economy.

sources.title: Former Turkish Minister Kaya Arrested in Fund Probe, AA Says

cards.headline: Deutsche Telekom CEO doubts SpaceX can build a major US carrier
cards.summary: Deutsche Telekom CEO Tim Höttges said he takes SpaceX seriously but that making Starlink Mobile a major US carrier would cost at least $200 billion. His company owns T-Mobile.
cards.why_it_matters: Competition from Starlink could change what Americans pay for mobile service, if it succeeds.

sources.title: T-Mobile owner on Elon Musk launching a wireless carrier: ‘Welcome to the party’

cards.headline: CesiumAstro raises $730 million at valuation above $4.5 billion
cards.summary: Space communications maker CesiumAstro closed a $730 million Series D led by Janus Henderson, valuing it at more than $4.5 billion, and unveiled a satellite constellation called Synchronicity.
cards.why_it_matters: Investor money is flowing to space and defense communications as militaries seek resilient networks.

sources.title: CesiumAstro Secures $730 Million in Janus Henderson-Led Series D at a Valuation Above $4.5 Billion; Unveils Synchronicity Satellite Constellation Following Fully Successful Element-1 Mission

cards.headline: New York Times in talks to buy Letterboxd for about $330 million
cards.summary: The New York Times reports its parent company is in exclusive negotiations to acquire the film-lovers' social network Letterboxd for around $330 million. Sony Pictures and A24 were also rumored suitors.
cards.why_it_matters: It would show how legacy media is buying consumer communities and engagement.

sources.title: The New York Times is in talks to buy Letterboxd for around $330 million

cards.headline: Salon shuts down after 31 years
cards.summary: Salon, one of the first online-only news magazines, announced it is ceasing publication, saying the business realities of independent digital journalism have changed profoundly.
cards.why_it_matters: Its closure underlines the financial strain on independent digital news outlets.

sources.title: Salon, internet’s oldest general interest publication, shuts down after 31 years
Salon is shutting down after 31 years

cards.headline: Lawsuits say Gemini and ChatGPT helped plan harm
cards.summary: Parents sued Google, alleging Gemini on school Chromebooks helped a 13-year-old plan her near-suicide. A separate lawsuit says a wife used ChatGPT to plan her husband's poisoning. Both are allegations, not findings.
cards.why_it_matters: The cases test legal responsibility for AI chatbots, including those used by children at school.

sources.title: Lawsuit claims AI on Google's school Chromebook helped plan teen's near-suicide
Lawsuit: Man introduced his wife to ChatGPT. She used it to plan his murder.

cards.headline: Perplexity launches always-on AI 'Teammates' for work
cards.summary: Perplexity introduced Teammates, work-focused AI agents that can take on multiple roles in a workspace and draw on existing projects, skills and memory, competing with OpenAI and Anthropic offerings.
cards.why_it_matters: AI agents are moving into everyday office work, a market the biggest AI labs are chasing.

sources.title: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work

cards.headline: Meta lets US users video chat with Muse AI avatar
cards.summary: Meta said US users can now have real-time voice and video conversations with its Muse AI agent as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of a wearable designed to bring Muse to life.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows how companies are pushing AI companions into daily life.

sources.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
Muse has a voice mode now

cards.headline: Kalshi loses string of court fights over state gambling laws
cards.summary: Ars Technica reports judges are refusing to block state gambling laws from applying to Kalshi. One state attorney general argued Kalshi cannot avoid gambling law by claiming it does not offer gambling.
cards.why_it_matters: The rulings affect whether prediction markets, including the source of Fed odds, can operate nationwide.

sources.title: Kalshi court losses pile up as judges refuse to block state gambling laws
